source.title: Harmony4D test/03_grappling2.zip, sequence 030_grappling2
source.author: Rawal Khirodkar, Jyun-Ting Song, Jinkun Cao, Zhengyi Luo, Kris Kitani (Carnegie Mellon University), Harmony4D, NeurIPS 2024
source.notes: Multi-view triangulated COCO-17 3D keypoints (processed_data/poses3d), 20 fps, both people. Floor fitted to ankles; hands are wrists, neck is mid-shoulders and head is mid-ears. Toes are not tracked and are inferred one foot-length ahead of each ankle along pelvis facing. Source camera cam01 sampled at pose indices 94, 106, 120, 134, 196, 230, 265 and 300. The images show two-person standing hand-fighting and close body contact; the overlap hides some arm and hand placement. This is a camera context check, not a verified technique label. No palm/sole contact labels are supplied or inferred. Converted from the released pose arrays with tools/motion/harmony4d/harmony_take.py conventions.
